payload.name: Beastly Roar
payload.description: Spawns a proximity AoE telegraph dealing magical damage at the boss's feet. Players must move to the opposite side of the arena to mitigate. When it resolves, it will additionally spawn a fast-moving set of circle AoEs that will travel clockwise or counterclockwise along the ring, so players must dodge in the opposite direction. Anyone hit by these will be temporarily stunned and knocked up. Using Sprint is recommended. The AoEs will complete slightly less than one full rotation. For uptime, tanks may opt to remain in melee range and use an invulnerability cooldown, although it may not be possible to dodge the rotating AoEs that temporarily stun.

payload.description: is used again, but now summons three orbs. In addition, this is combined with the turret line AoEs and Bloodmarch. The first orb will explode, followed by the turret line AoEs, followed by the second orb (which was teleported), and finally the third orb.

payload.name: Essentially
payload.description: If you have a flame ball, thaw a frozen player. If you have any ball, do not stand in a puddle until after your ball has resolved. When Ancient Flare starts being cast, stand in a puddle.

payload.name: How to avoid
payload.description: it's the same mechanic as Ancient Flare from the final boss in Labyrinth of Ancients formerly known as Acheron and now Phlegethon. Each group must stack on a small platform energized by the lightning orbs, which raises a shield that blocks the Daybreak cast. If stacking is not properly performed, then the shield fails.
